goal: Adds a compile-time non-null smart pointer wrapper so code no longer needs scattered runtime null-assertions
Applies the new type to several existing pointer members to make their non-null invariant self-documenting
reviewability: Ready to review now, no open blockers remain and the latest commit already got an ACK
agreement: Strong support: two experienced reviewers iterated for months and approved once concerns were fixed (stickies-v, l0rinc)
Suggestions to extend the pattern to more call sites were deferred as follow-ups, not blockers (l0rinc)

categories.name: indexes
why: P4 because it only swaps one member's raw Assert for a construction-time check in the LevelDB wrapper
No behavior change and benefit is limited to type-safety documentation

categories.name: mempool
why: P4 because it just wraps a return type for GetChangeSet with no change to mempool acceptance or fee logic
Side benefit is cleaner test code, not a functional improvement

categories.name: p2p
why: P4 because it only documents that the transport pointer is never null via a compile-time type
No change to connection handling or peer behavior

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it introduces a reusable safety primitive that removes the need for manual Assert-before-dereference
Two reviewers engaged deeply and endorsed the pattern, but adoption elsewhere is left to future PRs
Benefit is durable but forward-looking rather than fixing a concrete present bug

categories.name: validation
why: P4 because it is a passthrough refactor in validation files that changes no validation behavior
